character: A halfling man in his forties, about four feet tall, short and stocky, broad through the shoulders. Tidy brown curls, neatly groomed, clean-shaven. A wide warm open smile, cheeks lifted, the easy smile of a habitually cheerful man. Above it his eyebrows are raised and drawn hard together at the inner ends, deeply creasing the middle of his forehead, and his eyes are wide and frightened, glassy and unsteady, shadowed underneath
wardrobe: a long deep wine-red coat of figured silk brocade with a subtle woven pattern, gold-thread edging at the cuffs and collar, polished brass buttons, over an embroidered waistcoat in deep rose silk and a soft cream cravat pinned with a small gold pin. Every piece immaculate and slightly too formal for the wearer

full.framing: Full body standing portrait of a short stocky halfling, three-quarter view, hands clasped neatly in front of him.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, head and upper chest filling the frame, the same wide smile under frightened eyes and a creased worried brow.

scene.framing: A short halfling merchant standing behind a cloth merchant's counter stacked with bolts of fabric, a length of deep rose silk framed on the wall behind him, one hand resting near the silk square in his pocket.
